items.a: No. All monthly services are month-to-month — cancel any time with 30 days notice. App development projects have a one-time project agreement with no ongoing obligation.

items.q: What payment methods do you accept?
items.a: ACH bank transfer, check, and all major credit cards. Monthly service invoices are sent by email on the 1st of each month.

items.q: Do you serve clients outside Kansas?
items.a: Yes — all remote services (White Glove IT, AI App Development, and Senior Technology Concierge) are available nationwide. HaaS hardware deployment is currently Kansas and surrounding region.
